title: George Gumbs generating draft buzz as a wide receiver-turned edge rusher

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: George Gumbs generating draft buzz as a wide receiver-turned edge rusher
sources.description: College football players change positions often, but few start off as wide receivers and end up as edge rushers, and even fewer show the promise that Florida edge rusher George Gumbs has shown.
